title: Sagalee Callisu Gola Keessatti
intro: Kadhannaan tokko yeroo dheeraa dura tasgabbii kutaa qulqulluu tokkoo keessatti sagalee dhageessise, lubbuu dulloomtuu waan addunyaan akka hin danda’amne labsite hawwitu irraa ka’e. Lakkoofsi kun waggootaan guddatee fi yaaddoo egereetiin ba’aa ta’e kun kadhannaa dhuunfaatiin gara Gooftaa isaaniitti deebi’e. Wanti itti aanu deebii waaqummaa kan uumamaan eegamu hundumaa kan morme ture-karaa isa waamicha abdii kutannaa sanaaf deebii kennuuf ragaadha.
clues: Gola ibaadaa Isaatiif of kenne tokkotti of duuba deebi’ee dhuunfaan Gooftaa koo waamadhe.
Warra na booda dhufaniif akkan sodaadhe, al tokko deemeen qajeelfama saba kootiif akkan yaadda’e Gooftaa kootti amanee ture.
Dullumni na bira gaʼee ture—lafeen koo laafaa fi rifeensi adiin mataa koo irratti babalʼatee ture.
Haati manaa koo umurii ishee guutuu dhaaltuu turte, ta’us ammallee Gooftaan koo bakka isaa irraa dhaaltuu akka naaf kennu nan gaafadha.
Mallattoo gaafadhe, Gooftaan koo immoo halkan sadii nama kamiinuu akkan hin dubbanne na dhowwuun deebii naaf kenne, osoon qaamaan fayyaa ta’ee hafe.
Ilmi maqaan isaa Yahya ta'u waadaa naaf galame, maqaan Gooftaan koo kanaan dura nama tokkoof kennamee akka hin beekne labse.

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
